message.zh_CN: 服务器端口 $1 被占用
message.en_US: Server port $1 is already in use

suggest.zh_CN: 请检查端口 $1 是否被其它软件占用，或在服务端配置中更换端口
suggest.en_US: Check whether port $1 is used by other software, or change the port in the server config

message.zh_CN: Java 版本不兼容：Class 版本号 $1，对应 ($map_1)，请切换至正确的 JDK
message.en_US: Java version incompatible: Class version $1 ($map_1), please use correct JDK

suggest.zh_CN: 请更换为 Java ($map_1) 或更新版本
suggest.en_US: Please upgrade to Java ($map_1) or a newer version (e.g., Java 21 for latest servers).

message.zh_CN: 服务器端口被占用，无法绑定
message.en_US: Failed to bind to the server port

suggest.zh_CN: 该端口可能已被其它程序或另一个服务端占用，请更换端口或关闭占用它的程序
suggest.en_US: The port may be occupied by another program or server instance. Change the port or stop the occupying program.

message.zh_CN: 网络地址绑定失败（端口可能已被占用）
message.en_US: Failed to bind network address (port may already be in use)

suggest.zh_CN: 请确认端口未被占用，且应用已获得网络权限
suggest.en_US: Ensure the port is free and the app has been granted network permission

suggest.zh_CN: 请在启动参数中增大最大内存（-Xmx），或减少加载的模组 / 插件数量
suggest.en_US: Increase the maximum heap size (-Xmx) in the JVM arguments, or reduce the number of mods / plugins

match: Could not create the Java Virtual Machine

message.zh_CN: 无法创建 Java 虚拟机
message.en_US: Could not create the Java Virtual Machine

suggest.zh_CN: JVM 启动参数可能有误，请检查最大内存（-Xmx）是否超过设备可用内存
suggest.en_US: The JVM arguments may be invalid. Check whether the max memory (-Xmx) exceeds the available device RAM.

message.zh_CN: 无法访问服务端核心文件：$1

suggest.zh_CN: 请确认服务端核心文件存在且路径正确，未被移动或删除
suggest.en_US: Make sure the server jar exists at the correct path and has not been moved or deleted

match: Could not find or load main class (.*)

message.zh_CN: 找不到或无法加载主类：$1
message.en_US: Could not find or load main class: $1

suggest.zh_CN: 服务端核心可能损坏或不完整，建议重新下载服务端
suggest.en_US: The server jar may be corrupted or incomplete. Re-downloading the server is recommended.

message.zh_CN: 该 JAR 不是可执行的服务端核心（缺少主清单属性）
message.en_US: This JAR is not an executable server (no main manifest attribute)

suggest.zh_CN: 请确认选择的是正确的服务端核心文件，而非普通的库文件
suggest.en_US: Make sure you selected the correct server jar, not a plain library file

match: agree to the (?:EULA|Minecraft End User License Agreement)

message.zh_CN: 需要先同意 Minecraft EULA 才能启动服务器
message.en_US: You must agree to the Minecraft EULA before starting the server

suggest.zh_CN: 请将实例目录下 eula.txt 中的 eula 改为 true（即同意最终用户许可协议）
suggest.en_US: Set eula=true in eula.txt inside the instance directory (accept the End User License Agreement)

suggest.zh_CN: 请检查 PocketMine 版本与插件的兼容性，或查看完整日志定位问题
suggest.en_US: Check PocketMine version and plugin compatibility, or inspect the full log to locate the issue

message.zh_CN: 无法解析主机地址：$1（网络异常）

suggest.zh_CN: 请检查设备网络连接，部分服务端首次启动需要联网下载依赖
suggest.en_US: Check the device network connection. Some servers need internet access to download dependencies on first run.

message.zh_CN: 服务端核心文件（$1）无效或损坏
message.en_US: Server core file ($1) is invalid or corrupted

suggest.zh_CN: 重新下载服务端核心文件
